notes.title: More Challenges - Bonus Levels
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Teodoro first Major Update is finally out bringing more levels for you to challenge yourself after restoring the beauty of the Peaceful Forest and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39640163/4b02a3e0e26074036faedfcd8ebf1760f63ef024.png[/img]

[h2]Bonus Levels[/h2]
We added [b]30 Bonus Levels[/b] for the ones who want to challenge themselves a little more... and, of course, we added an [b]Achievement[/b] for when you beat all of them.

[h2]Other updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Binds added for all the buttons of the HUD.
[*] Bug fixes;
[/list]
[h2]Thank you[/h2]
Finally, thank you for all the support you guys have shown by reviewing the game, making videos of first impressions, gameplays, and thank you for everyone who’s bought and played Teodoro so far. We’re going to continue making amazing games, keep an eye out!
